objective: Run a UI/UX quality audit and design review on FloatNotes (ui-ux-pro-max audit stack + hallmark), producing ranked evidence-backed findings and a ship/no-ship verdict. Apply no fixes.

deep-research.reason: Tool selection was already litigated in the source plan's shortlist table. Every open question Stage 1 surfaced resolved against local source (axum cfg(debug_assertions) proxy, the four Tauri guards, the opaque bg-white root, the ACAO:* middleware) — no external evidence needed. The one genuinely external unknown, Chrome's Private Network Access behavior on loopback, is settled empirically by the audit's own Playwright probe rather than by reading the web.

blueprint.note: Adopted the user-supplied approved plan as the blueprint rather than generating a new one; Stage 1 proposes five amendments for the grill to ratify.

grill.note: Five questions asked; plan amended in place. ADR 0011 was a factual correction applied without a grill question (it rests on directly verified source: the app root is opaque bg-white), not a judgment call put to the user.

walkthrough.note: 14 units, 12 agent-ready, 2 agent-ready:no (physical — quit/restore the user's running app). Surfaced that ADR 0009 was unworkable (bare playwright import) and corrected the Stage 1 brief's claim about focus-visible coverage; both folded back into the ADRs.

linearize.reason: User decision D2 at the walkthrough: the audit is strictly sequential with zero parallel steps, runs ~2.5h, and ends in a human-read verdict — decomposing it into a todo chain is pure orchestration overhead. The runsheet is the checklist instead.

sweep.reason: Same decision (D2) — direct sequential execution rather than an autonomous sweep. Two runsheet units are agent-ready:no (physical) anyway, so a sweep would have parked on them.

notes: Invoked as /apex with an existing approved plan (.plans/ui-ux-audit.md) rather than a bare objective — Stage 3 adopts that plan as the blueprint instead of generating a new one.
Integration branch is chore/ui-ux-audit (not feat/) — the work is tooling + a report, not a feature. Supersedes the plan's proposed chore/ui-ux-audit-tooling.
Branch cut with CLAUDE_TREE_OVERRIDE=1 at the user's explicit direction; the branch guard reported another live session owning this checkout.
